description: Runs one batch of actions on an open session and returns the fresh page. Each action is an object, e.g. {"action":"click","selector":"#go"}. DRIVE: navigate, click, fill, type_text, select, check, hover, submit, press_key, scroll, back, wait, wait_for. SEE: query_dom, find_text, read_text, count, get_attributes, inspect, list_candidates, get_dom, get_screenshot. NETWORK: capture_network, get_request, rotate_exit. CODE: evaluate_js, search_scripts, read_script. RECORD: extract {variable,script}, api_call (a flow is built step by step with writ_browser_compose add_flow_step), login_post, probe_write, confirm_write. 2FA: twofa {challenge_method}. A value written {{name}} with its real value in `inputs` becomes a workflow input. Each action's arguments: the session's start answer, or writ_help('writ_browser_act').
name: writ_browser_act
title: Act in a browser session
